Package io.jengacode.eduvideo.math

Class CalculusObject

java.lang.Object
io.jengacode.eduvideo.scene.SceneObject
io.jengacode.eduvideo.math.CalculusObject
public final class CalculusObject extends SceneObject
Live calculus construction inside a coordinate plane. PARAM_A controls secant displacement or Riemann rectangle count. Function evaluation and labels use the same mathematical samples. The derivative is a central numerical difference, explicitly distinct from symbolic algebra.

    • CalculusObject

      public CalculusObject(String id, String expression, String mode, double point, double from, double to)
      Creates a secant/tangent or midpoint-Riemann demonstration for a finite expression.
      Parameters:
      id - stable nonblank identity, unique in its owning namespace
      expression - safe arithmetic expression in x
      mode - supported construction or plotting mode
      point - fixed mathematical x coordinate of the first secant point
      from - source position or start of the requested mathematical/render interval
      to - destination position or end of the requested mathematical/render interval
